description_html:
Key Features

  • Large Growing Area: Offers a spacious 32.1 square meters of cultivation space, ideal for maximizing plant yield in indoor or greenhouse environments.
  • Fogponic Brine-Mist System: Utilizes advanced fogponic technology, delivering nutrient-rich brine mist directly to plant roots for optimal growth and nutrient absorption.
  • Precise Root Zone Temperature: Maintains a consistent root zone temperature of 22°C, supporting healthy root development and reducing plant stress.
  • High Capacity: Accommodates up to 56 individual plant slots, making it suitable for both commercial growers and research applications.
  • Passive Capillary Irrigation: Features a passive capillary irrigation system, ensuring even and reliable water distribution to all plants with minimal maintenance.
  • Defined Growth Cycle: Designed for a 179-day growth cycle, supporting long-term cultivation and crop planning.
  • Customizable Pricing: Unit price is determined upon acceptance, allowing for tailored solutions based on specific project requirements.

Main Benefits

  • Maximized Yield: The large surface area and multiple plant slots enable efficient use of space, increasing overall production per cycle.
  • Optimized Plant Health: Consistent root temperature and fogponic nutrient delivery promote faster growth, stronger roots, and higher crop quality.
  • Water and Nutrient Efficiency: Passive capillary irrigation minimizes water waste and ensures each plant receives the nutrients it needs, supporting sustainable agriculture practices.
  • Low Maintenance: The passive system reduces the need for constant monitoring, making it user-friendly for growers seeking reliable, hands-off operation.
  • Flexible Integration: Suitable for a variety of environments including commercial greenhouses, research facilities, and urban farms.

Typical Use Cases or Outcomes

  • Commercial Hydroponic Farming: Ideal for businesses seeking to scale up plant production with minimal resource input and high reliability.
  • Urban or Indoor Agriculture: Perfect for maximizing plant density in limited spaces, such as vertical farms or rooftop gardens.
  • Research and Development: Provides controlled conditions for plant scientists and agricultural researchers to study root development, nutrient uptake, and crop cycles.
  • Sustainable Growing Solutions: Supports eco-friendly farming methods by optimizing water use and reducing the need for soil-based cultivation.

Frequently Asked Questions

  • Is the system easy to use? Yes, the passive capillary irrigation system is designed for straightforward setup and low maintenance.
  • How durable is the rack? Engineered for long-term use over 179-day cycles, making it a reliable choice for ongoing cultivation.
  • What types of plants can I grow? Suitable for a wide range of crops commonly grown in hydroponic, fogponic, and aeroponic systems.
  • Is the temperature adjustable? The system maintains a stable root zone temperature of 22°C, ideal for most plant species requiring controlled environments.
  • How is pricing determined? Pricing is customized based on project needs and is provided after acceptance of the order.
